minecolonies:gunner.job.desc: Equipped with firearms from Iron's Artifice. Delivers devastating ranged volleys and kites enemies.
Introduce gunpowder weaponry to the colony defense.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.gunner: Unlocks Gunner as a new Guard Type (Firearms) in Guard Towers.
minecolonies:mage.job.desc: Harnesses arcane arts from Iron's Spells. Casts offensive and supportive spells to protect the colony.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.mage.su: Train colony guards in the arts of spellcasting.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.mage.d: Unlocks Mage as a new Guard Type (Spellbooks) in Guard Towers.
